source.sqlReaderQuery:
select 
'Num' as Num,
'RAW_DATA_ID'  as RAW_DATA_ID,
'CustomerNumber' as CustomerNumber,
'SalesOrg' as SalesOrg,
'DistributionChannel' as DistributionChannel,
'PartnerFunction' as PartnerFunction,
'PartnerNumber'  as PartnerNumber,
'REC_EFF_DT' as REC_EFF_DT,
'REC_EXP_DT' as REC_EXP_DT,
'REC_CRT_DT' as REC_CRT_DT
union all
-- select * from (
select 
str(Num) as Num,
-- convert(varchar,Num) as Num,
cast(RAW_DATA_ID as nvarchar) as RAW_DATA_ID,
CustomerNumber,
SalesOrg,
DistributionChannel,
PartnerFunction,
cast(PartnerNumber as nvarchar) as PartnerNumber,
REC_EFF_DT,
REC_EXP_DT,
REC_CRT_DT
 from (
select row_number() over(order by RAW_DATA_ID ) as Num,
*
from (
select 
cast(RAW_DATA_ID as nvarchar) as RAW_DATA_ID,
CustomerNumber,
SalesOrg,
DistributionChannel,
PartnerFunction,
cast(PartnerNumber as nvarchar) as PartnerNumber,
REC_EFF_DT,
REC_EXP_DT,
REC_CRT_DT
 from [MVIEW].[MIC_CustomerPartner]
where SalesOrg in('CN23','CN14') and DistributionChannel='01'
)t 
)a
-- order by Num asc
-- )
